title: Painting Services in Dunnellon, FL | Full Service List
description: Painting services in Dunnellon, FL: interiors, exteriors, cabinets, decks, fences, washing, stucco and drywall repair, and specialty coatings from one crew.
heroIntro: A complete look at the painting, staining, repair, and coating services we offer Dunnellon homes and businesses, and how to decide what your property actually needs right now.

secondary: dunnellon fl painting and staining services
questions: What painting services can I get in Dunnellon, FL?
Which project should I do first on an older house?
Do you offer specialty finishes and coatings?

body: A Dunnellon property usually has more painted and coated surfaces than the owner realizes: siding or stucco, trim and porch rails, interior walls and ceilings, cabinets, a deck, a fence, a garage floor, maybe a stained front door. Our painting services in Dunnellon, FL cover all of them with the same crews and a single itemized estimate, so the work is sequenced properly instead of stacked up between contractors.

When budgets are limited, we recommend the order that protects the building. Anything letting water in comes first: peeling fascia, soft window sills, open caulk joints, stucco cracks that are widening. Exterior coatings follow. Interior and cosmetic work can wait for the next phase without risk. On the historic Cracker houses downtown, porch floors and rails often move up the list because they take the most wear.
If you are unsure how long your current exterior has left, read how long exterior paint lasts in Florida.

body: Limewash in particular suits older masonry and gives a soft, mottled look that pairs well with historic architecture. Our specialty services page explains each of these in more depth.

The same service list applies whether the property is your own house, a rental between tenants, or a storefront downtown. Rentals usually call for durable, easily matched colors and a fast turnaround between occupants. Businesses need work scheduled around opening hours, which can mean nights or weekends. Homeowners tend to want the least disruption to daily life, so crews work room by room and protect furniture rather than asking anyone to move out.

sections.h2: Products and standards across every service
body: Whatever the service, the standards are the same: premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore products named on the estimate, two full coats as the baseline, and a punch walk that you sign. Low-VOC options are available for interiors. For a sense of who we are in town, visit our Dunnellon painting contractor page, or jump straight to washing and cleaning services if the house just needs a refresh.

faqs.q: Can I bundle several services on one Dunnellon estimate?
faqs.a: Yes. Washing, repairs, painting, and staining can all be listed on one itemized estimate, which also lets you phase work over time.

faqs.q: Do you do garage floor coatings?
faqs.a: Yes. We install garage floor epoxy and polyaspartic coatings as part of our specialty services.

faqs.q: Do you subcontract any of these services?
faqs.a: No. Our own crews perform the work, and the person who prices the job stays involved until you sign off.
